source_identity_policy: Keep every original run ID, block, study, arm, repeat, assignment, and evidence binding unchanged. Add source provenance; never relabel hard-v2 as v1.
validation_policy: Independently rerun each source campaign's frozen row validator and require byte-equivalent canonical metric rows before combination.
rank_policy: Derive hard directional-rank endpoints only from the hard-v2 bundle's independently validated frozen pool and preferences; do not borrow v1 hard artifacts.
multiplicity_policy: Use the original within-family-and-endpoint Holm corrections exactly as frozen.
exclusion_policy: No v1 hard pilot row may enter the 240-run combined denominator.
adaptive_policy: No adaptive contrast, endpoint, denominator, retry, row selection, or outcome-based stopping changes are permitted.
